label: HYPOTHESIS_GENERATING_S0

authority.discovery_mode_amendment: S0-classified empirical screening permitted for hypothesis generation only

clocks_used.signal_bar_label: ts_init = bar close time; bar spans [ts-15m, ts)
clocks_used.feature_inputs_pit: only bars <= ts, walk-forward ranks vs trailing 672 completed bars excluding current bar where noted
clocks_used.fill_clock: next event after signal bar close = open[t+1]

multiple_testing_denominator_estimate.note: counts derived from the per-row tallies in e0_findings_v10.md section 2; every test looks at the same inspected window, so none carries out-of-sample credit

observable_construction.primary_gate: wf_rank(log1p(trade_count), lookback=672 bars) < 0.30 AND wf_rank(range/close, lookback=672) > 0.85 AND close > open on the same completed bar
observable_construction.neighbour_gate: same with count rank < 0.40 and range rank > 0.75
observable_construction.entry: short at next-event open after the signal bar completes
observable_construction.concurrency_rule_measured: one position per symbol, signals skipped while in trade

near_miss_documentation_not_a_proposal.economic_source_and_counterparty: illiquid markup: an upward thrust printed without two-sided participation finds no resting depth and no fresh buyer confirmation, so the marginal chaser pays for liquidity that does not exist; counterparty is the late buyer of the thin-book wick
why_rejected: fails the later Stage-A constraint set already at screen level: PF estimate below 1.10 on both legs under non-overlap sizing and negative after a 1.5x fee stress on BTC (~breakeven) while ETH stays negative
expectancy is tail-loaded onto clustered cascade days (sd ~140 bp vs median near zero), i.e. dependent on holding through the worst execution conditions
the favourable overlapping-sample statistic double-counts the same decline windows and inverts once one-position-per-symbol sampling is imposed
proposing it would burn scarce V10 scored cells on an artifact that this document itself demonstrates
would_change_the_verdict_if: funding/clock companions show short-perp carry income large enough to move net expectancy by >=10 bp per trade without changing the gate
an independent implementation on the five unscreenable S0 symbols reproduced the direction with the same parameters

grounding_facts_for_blind_agents_not_cre: unconditional mean fwd16 drift was small and negative in the screened window: -1.93 bp (BTC) and -2.15 bp (ETH)

a wide-range up-bar printed with trade count in the bottom tail of its trailing distribution preceded ~20x baseline-concentrated downside drift when overlapping holds are counted; this concentration collapses to marginal/negative expectancy under fixed-size single-position sampling

low realised-vol states showed better forward drift than high-vol states in all three chronological folds and both symbols, but a tradable walk-forward state machine on that signal lost 8.6-23.3 bp per trade net of 10 bp round-trip costs; regime octile tables are not tradeable evidence
aggressor-flow imbalance (taker buy share), hour-of-day drift, day-of-week drift, ticket-size anomaly and BTC-to-ETH lagged lead-lag were all unstable or empty on this window
limitations: two-symbol evidence only; five of seven frozen S0 symbols had no local data and were never screened
no funding, clock, OI, basis or book data present locally, so all funding-dependent variants were untestable and unproposed
final ~21.7 h of the declared S0 window missing from local bars

grep over research/hypotheses accidentally surfaced one line of historical V1 expectancies from _analysis_v2/v1_negative_analysis.md and one historical scan pass count inside H-VOLCOMP-BRKOUT-v1/hypothesis.md; neither file was opened further and neither figure informed any output
